experiences.title: Changing leaves & woodland phenophases
experiences.what: Watch different tree species move from colored leaves to leaf drop; report actual dates from a known tree
experiences.caution: A statewide maple report cannot confirm leaf color in a particular town
experiences.source: Existing Michigan Phenology calendar and USA-NPN leaf observations

experiences.title: Southbound marsh birds
experiences.what: Check marshes and bay edges for changing flocks; migration varies with weather
experiences.caution: Calls or sightings do not independently prove the timing of a migratory movement
experiences.source: Existing Michigan Phenology fall migration calendar

experiences.title: First frosts & the autumn garden
experiences.what: Compare overnight minima, skies and actual observed frost before deciding what to protect
experiences.caution: Weather suitability is not an observed frost event

experiences.title: Lake smoke and freeze-up clues
experiences.what: Compare lake-to-air temperature contrast, cold-air outbreaks and shore exposure
experiences.caution: Cold air alone does not confirm lake smoke or safe ice

experiences.title: Large-flowered trillium
experiences.scope: Broad spring calendar; reported-flowering history is regional
experiences.what: Look for buds and open flowers in permitted woodland places and record the stage
experiences.caution: Historical report weeks do not establish first bloom at a preserve
experiences.source: Existing Trillium Tracker and independently tested reporting archive

experiences.title: Ruby-throated hummingbirds
experiences.what: Prepare a clean feeder before the usual first-report window and watch for actual arrivals
experiences.caution: First public reports are not confirmed first biological arrivals
experiences.source: Existing Hummingbird Tracker and independently tested reporting archive

experiences.title: Spring salamander movements
experiences.what: Look for managed education walks and compare thaw, rain and temperature
experiences.caution: Suitable weather is not a confirmed migration or a publicly accessible crossing

experiences.title: Frog and toad chorus
experiences.what: Listen for different calls near permitted wetland edges on mild evenings
experiences.caution: Weather ratings do not verify calls or animal abundance

experiences.title: Woodcock sky dance
experiences.what: Check published viewing opportunities and listen at dusk from permitted ground
experiences.caution: Seasonal timing is not a recorded display at a particular site

experiences.title: Firefly emergence & warm nights
experiences.what: Look for flashes at safe, dark grassy edges during warm quiet evenings
experiences.caution: A warm night does not prove adult emergence; species have different clocks

experiences.title: Michigan flowering destinations
experiences.what: Check dated venue reports before traveling for blossoms or seasonal displays
experiences.caution: Published display schedules do not confirm flowers open today
